answer_1.quote: Abstractive Multi-Document Summarization (MDS), the task of writing a consolidated summary of the main information from multiple documents ...

answer_2.quote: We evaluate our models via automatic evaluation metrics using ROUGE, as well as human evaluations of informativeness, coherence, and factual consistency.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation on Amazon MTurk to analyze the effect of adding graph input to the BART-Long model ... Informativeness: The more informative summary is better at expressing the main points ... Coherence: The more coherent summary has better structure and flow ...
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators judge summaries on informativeness (main points coverage), coherence (structure and logical flow), and factual consistency (agreement with source articles).
